score_evidence.A: Coherent arc (attack surface -> six lineages -> cross-lineage transfer -> asymmetry/comparison -> paradox -> close); all headings are noun-phrase claims; all 24 plan papers cited. Deductions: L666 says '아래 비교표는 이 비대칭을 논문별로 정리한 것입니다' but three prose subsections (L668-680) come before the table at L682; numbers are split over two result tables (L652-658 and L682-705), against the survey-numbers-in-one-table rule; the AgentDojo overview figure (L336) sits at the end of the benchmark section after its limitations paragraph instead of where AgentDojo is introduced (L288).
score_evidence.B: Register break in a figure caption: L336 '...보안을 평가한다.' (rewrite: '...보안을 함께 평가하는 AgentDojo'). Pipeline/input meta leaks: L640 '같은 설정에서 측정한 PoisonedRAG 자체의 ASR 값은 여기서 옮기지 않았으므로, 아래 비교는 상대적 순서만 다룹니다' (drop; give 0.97); L634 '기반 LLM의 이름과, 범위가 ... 어느 변형에 해당하는지는 이 결과와 함께 제시되지 않았습니다'. Formulaic hedging tails repeated: L252 '이는 이 글의 해석입니다.', L290 '이 판단은 글쓴이의 해석입니다.', L314 '이 예시는 글쓴이가 든 가상의 사례입니다.', L318 '이 취지는 글쓴이의 해석입니다.', L362 '이 대입은 설명을 위한 가상의 예입니다.', L382 '이 역시 가상의 예입니다.' (fold into the sentence: '가상의 예로, ...'). English default verb L558 '프롬프트 최적화기 역할을 합니다' (-> '프롬프트 최적화기처럼 지시를 다듬습니다'). English fragments in table cells: L687 'GPT-4 combination_3 Bad Bot 0.94', L688 'Vicuna-7B harmful string ASR 88%'.
score_evidence.C: False back-reference: L542 '이 문구가 두 모델 모두에서 메모리 중요도 점수를 거의 최댓값까지 끌어올린다는 결과는 앞 절에서 수치와 함께 다뤘습니다' - no earlier section gives the 10 / 9.84 scores. Facts restated: ToolHijacker's one-document, retrieval+selection definition at L616, again at L632 and L674; tree-of-attack gradient-free optimisation at L620 and L632; BadAgent 13B scope at L512, L678 and L694; AgentPoison perplexity overlap at L506 and L648; Marking bypass at L554 and L674. The running assistant-agent example ties sections together well.
score_evidence.D: Hard parts get help where they appear: SecAlign DPO worked numbers (L394), AgentPoison uniqueness/compactness losses explained term by term (L494), GCG candidate-vs-exact-loss design reason (L176), PoisonedRAG retrieval/generation split with a worked assistant example (L468). Minor padding from repeated assistant-agent restatements (e.g. L670, L674, L731).
score_evidence.E: Figures referred to descriptively and placed by their discussion, equations used for each method. Deductions: L336 caption uses paper numbering '그림 1:'; the comparison table (L682-705) omits SmoothLLM and ETDI; L655-656 '방어' cells are '—'; English cell fragments (L687-688); 'Claude 2.1%' at L688 is ambiguous (Claude-2 at 2.1%, reads as Claude 2.1).
score_evidence.F: 1 wrong claim of 15 checked: L634/L654 put StruQ and SecAlign together at 'ASR 84.6%~97.5%' and say the variant split is not given; ToolHijacker Table IX gives 84.6-97.5% for SecAlign only, StruQ is 90.8-99.6%, and every cell is split by gradient-free/gradient-based (also a false claim about what the paper leaves out). All other sampled numbers matched cell for cell.
score_evidence.S1: Comparison table omits two plan papers (SmoothLLM, ETDI). Limitation cells are mostly the papers' own (BadAgent L694 matches its Limitations; CaMeL L702), but L684 '완전한 방어 보장 없음' is the paper's conclusion rather than a limitation and L687 '비공개 모델에 의한 간접 검증' is unclear. The cross-lineage and asymmetry sections re-explain ToolHijacker, Marking and ETDI already covered in their cards (L632, L674).
